messages:
kayla: Postmortem follow-up for incident 3120043210 — condensed action list. Problem: reconnect storms + aggressive keepalive = KV cache churn -> timeouts + partial chunks. We split work into three parallel tracks: runtime heartbeat, client backoff/circuit, and routing soft-fallback + alerts.

jorge: I'll take runtime heartbeat tuning. Plan: idle_keepalive=15s, jitter=0.2, max_missed=3, prefetch_cache_ttl=30s. Canary to staging; will report partial_chunk_rate before/after. ETA: Wed EOD.

mei: I'll own client SDK backoff and circuit-breaker. Proposal: exp backoff capped at 30s, max_attempts=6, client-side circuit when partial_rate>5% over 60s; add opt-in header for graceful-downgrade to non-stream path. PR + integration tests by Tue AM.

sre-bot: Suggested alert: composite alarm if partial_response_rate > 2% AND queue_growth > 20% over 5m. Escalation to SRE lead if partial_response_rate > 3% for 5m.

ops-bot: Created INF-5733 "Streaming surge thresholds + fallback runbook" https://redwood/INF-5733. Assigned owners: runtime, SDK, ops.

oncall-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: heartbeat config to staging at 3135012000 UTC.

kayla: Timeline recap: Jorge (runtime Wed EOD), Mei (SDK Tue AM), Ops (runbook Fri EOD). Observation window 4 weeks; rollback if partial_response_rate > 3% sustained. Priority: add tracing for partial chunks to close observability gap. Link PRs & test results in INF-5733 before Tue sync at 09:30 PT. Thanks. :wave:
